# Asana

## Addresses

- Home: `https://app.asana.com/0/home`
- Inbox: `https://app.asana.com/0/inbox`
- My tasks: `https://app.asana.com/0/my_tasks`

## How it behaves

- It runs on the browser session. If you get sent to `/-/login?u=...`, hold on to the encoded `u` value and carry on to it once signed in.
- Copied task and project links are the reliable way back to something.
- For work assigned to the user, My tasks is the safest place to start.
- Most task actions happen in the details pane on the right, which updates in place. Snapshot again after opening a task.

## Keys

Most shortcuts are `Tab` followed by a letter.

| Action | Keys |
| --- | --- |
| Search | `Tab+/` |
| Quick add a task | `Tab+Q` |
| Home / Inbox / My tasks | `Tab+H` / `Tab+I` / `Tab+Z` |
| Due date | `Tab+D` |
| Add to a project | `Tab+P` |
| Subtasks | `Tab+S` |
| Comment | `Tab+C` |
| Collaborators | `Tab+F` |
| Assign to me | `Tab+M` |
| New section | `Tab+N` |
| New task / new task above | `Enter` / `Shift+Enter` |
| Close the details pane | `Escape` |
| Next / previous inbox item | `J` / `K` |
| Archive the selected inbox item | `I` or `E` |
